hypotheses.N0_factor_program_is_exact: Local factor recomposition has maximum relative error at most 1e-5 and the all-block recurrence matches every direct gradient.
hypotheses.N1_qk_routing_replication: The early QK-only program reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.90 and 10th percentile at least 0.75.
hypotheses.N2_qk_routing_is_causally_useful: QK-selected top-64 coalitions increase semantic score at least 95% of the time and recover at least 80% of exact mean finite shift.
hypotheses.N3_value_transport_is_insufficient: The early value-only program has median gradient cosine below 0.85.
hypotheses.N4_value_adds_limited_increment_beyond_q: The full early program exceeds QK-only by less than 0.08 median gradient cosine.
hypotheses.N5_two_qk_factors_are_complementary: QK1 plus QK2 beats the better individual QK factor by at least 0.05 median gradient cosine.
hypotheses.N6_qk_routing_transfers_across_features: Every feature has median QK-only gradient cosine at least 0.80 and finite directional fraction at least 0.75.
hypotheses.N7_no_single_qk_factor_plus_value_is_suf: Both QK1-plus-value and QK2-plus-value remain below 0.90 median gradient cosine.
